title: The deploy sits 70 MB under its 8 GB write limit, so the next dependency bump fails the build: cut what every function carries

source.ref: Production b2014f6 (#5103) read 7.93 GB across 641 functions on 2026-11-16; the minor-and-patch group #5098 preview failed at 8.41 GB.

detail: MEASURED 2026-11-16. Production b2014f6 wrote 7.93 GB across 641 functions against the 8 GB budget (99 percent). Dependabot's minor-and-patch group (#5098) failed check:build-budget at 8.41 GB. Its biggest-costs list, size x functions carrying it: libvips-cpp.so 909 MB (17.8 MB x 51), the server root chunk 586 MB (1.4 MB x 430), next's app-page runtime 432 MB (x 640), two node_modules chunks 422 and 391 MB, @sentry/conventions attributes.cjs 288 MB (0.6 MB x 519), _0 chunk 277 MB, @sentry/server-runtime-injection's vendored meriyah 161 MB (x 519), zod v4 classic 140 MB (x 376), lib/ai/client 127 MB (x 369). Sentry 11.12 is held back on #5098 until this has room. Both Sentry packages are real runtime dependencies of @sentry/core and the server hook, so they cannot simply be excluded from the trace. WORK, in order of measured size and safety: (1) content/help/** sits in outputFileTracingIncludes under '/**', which is 293 KB in every function (about 185 MB), only so the (main) layout can build Vera's 34 KB search index from disk on each request. Serve the index as one statically generated route the launcher fetches when it opens. Then narrow the include to the routes that read help Markdown at runtime. That also takes 34 KB of index out of every member page's payload. (2) 23 page functions carry libvips (about 410 MB) only because they share a segment with a per-entity opengraph-image. Move those cards to explicit image routes so the page does not inherit the rasteriser. (3) lib/ai/client in 369 functions and zod v4 in 376 are fan-out from a shared module: find the import that pulls them into every route. Do not raise BUDGET_GB. PROGRESS 2026-11-16: step 1 shipped in #5109; production ccb1795 (with #5098's 24 updates, Sentry held at 11.10) reads 7.89 GB, container peak 6920 MB. Step 3 traced: the SDK reaches the (main) layout through a server action the layout's own client components call (capture-launcher > mindless > on-air/actions > vera-dispatch > lib/ai/complete), so splitting aiEnabled out of lib/ai/client frees only about 39 entries (~13 MB); not worth a change on its own. Step 2 (the per-entity cards, about 410 MB) is the one real lever left, and about 25 probes and tests pin the opengraph-image paths. .github/dependabot.yml now ignores @sentry/* 11.11+ so the weekly group does not fail again while this is open. OWNER RULING 2026-11-16 21:58Z (decision card): step 2 waits until after the Jan 1 launch; Sentry stays on 11.10 until then.

verify.evidence: Fails today: production b2014f6 printed 'check:build-budget - 7.93 GB across 641 functions, under the 8 GB budget'. Passes when a production build log prints check:build-budget at or under 7.2 GB, with BUDGET_GB still 8, and the Sentry update from #5098 merged.
